pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anācāraṃ ācaritvā aññāṇakena āpannā 'ti jānantū 'ti pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.3: idān' eva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayam pi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vakkhanti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.7: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadetha . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vakkhatha . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.16: idān' eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi ayam pi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.17: tañ ce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvittikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne ko pana vādo bhiyyo, na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi yañ ca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno tañ ca yathādhammo kāretabbo, uttari c' assa moho āropetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.18: tassa te āvuso alābhā tassa te dulladdhaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikarosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.11: aññāṇakena āpanno 'ti jānantū 'ti pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.12: idān' eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi . . . āgacchatīti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.13: tañ ce 'ti mohetukāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ, bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā . . . moho āropetabbo. evañ ca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.17: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne ne sādhukaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikaroti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.18: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno mohaṃ āropeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.23: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno mohassa āropanā, so tuṇh' assa.
